query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS revenueEntries (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  saleId INT NOT NULL,
  revenueAccountId INT NOT NULL,
  amount DECIMAL(10, 2) NOT NULL,
  entryType ENUM('CREDITO', 'DEBITO') NOT NULL,
  description VARCHAR(200),
  entryDate TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX sale_idx (saleId),
  INDEX account_idx (revenueAccountId),
  INDEX entry_date_idx (entryDate)
);
